content: I would propose "Hack Meetup: Building a Better Porchfest" to honor the source of the inspiration
"PorchREST" would be a great name if you built out an API. Just sayin haha

The Bluesky folks in Boston are putting Porchfest on the "Atmosphere" (analogous to the Fediverse):

https://blacksky.community/profile/did:plc:pqerwmnouevyltxyoayhholf/post/3mlge5zvv2k2a
They have events and maps built into the system I guess. Atmosphere is pretty nice but of course it's somewhat more centralized. They're in an interesting middle zone.
I guess they already have "multi-events".
Conferences etc

It's so much easier to sell a company on making an integration. Bluesky has a bunch of users. Things are automatically compatible. It's pretty nice. It bothers me because I prefer the Fediverse :sweat_smile:.

There's also this unofficial Somerville Porchfest map:

https://www.porchfest.io/

There's also https://viewporchfest.com which I heard about at https://omny.fm/shows/wbz-newsradio-1030-news-audio/attending-somerville-porchfest-interactive-map-might-help-you-plan

It also says it's powered by Atmosphere.

They interview the creator about it. The transcript says "Tim Sakaroff" but I wonder that's a misspelling and if it's this guy: https://www.timsakharov.com
Huh.
Okay well that sort of covers our use case. Not sure the usability on the run is what I'd want.
Oh wow I think this is coincidentally a different Atmosphere.
Well I'm gonna use viewporchfest. I have an hour and change to kill before my Amtrak home :grinning_face_with_smiling_eyes:

Well it seems like everyone and their sister is building porchfest apps now haha

Dan said:

Oh wow I think this is coincidentally a different Atmosphere.

A different one? I've never even heard of it.

Seems like it. There's the name (or nickname?) for the ecosystem around BlueSky, and there's what appears to be some sort of company making a platform for events (such as Porchfest here). I'd never heard of the latter either.
So are we still thinking of building any porchfest maps? Brookline Porchfest is on Sep 26th: https://www.brooklineporchfest.org

A possible direction:

  • Make a repo at https://github.com/bostonopen/porchfest
  • Make directory: brookline
    • Make directory: brookline/2025
      • Vibe code something based on the 2025 KML: #boston > Hack Meetup: Building a Better Porchfest Map @ 💬
    • Make directory: brookline/2026
      • Wait for the KML to be published
      • Make a 2026 version based on the 2025 version
Did the ATProto people end up coming up with something?

Well, there's https://www.porchfest.io and https://viewporchfest.com and yes, at least one of them was done by ATproto people. @Tynan Purdy would probably know. I don't know if either one is open source.

some stuff was made but hasn't moved in a bit afaik. For sure some of my folks would be interested in working together on it if y'all want to do it. We sketched out a data model to put it on atproto and someone made a client that just has manual data on a map at https://porchfest.at
